target.rawSql: SELECT timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => route_seconds) AS time, run || ' route end' AS text FROM runs WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND route_seconds IS NOT NULL

targets.rawSql: SELECT run, variant, machine, mode, preset, verdict, fps_mean AS "fps", fps_1pct_low AS "1% low", p50_ms AS "p50", p99_ms AS "p99", p99_9_ms AS "p99.9", max_ms AS "max", over_33ms AS ">33 ms", jitter_ms AS "jitter", gpu_ms_mean AS "GPU ms", cpu_pct AS "CPU %", busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core %", gpu_pct AS "GPU %", game_thread_pct AS "game thread %", chunk_p99_ms AS "chunk p99", gc_events AS "GC pauses", total_w AS "power W", j_per_frame AS "J/frame" FROM runs WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started

panels.title: Change vs the base run (%)
panels.description: Green = better: higher fps / 1% low, lower frame times, spikes, jitter, latency. Utilization is left uncoloured (higher is better only below the cap).

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.run, round((100.0 * (r.fps_mean - b.fps_mean) / nullif(b.fps_mean, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "fps", round((100.0 * (r.fps_1pct_low - b.fps_1pct_low) / nullif(b.fps_1pct_low, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "1% low", round((100.0 * (r.p50_ms - b.p50_ms) / nullif(b.p50_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "p50", round((100.0 * (r.p99_ms - b.p99_ms) / nullif(b.p99_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "p99", round((100.0 * (r.p99_9_ms - b.p99_9_ms) / nullif(b.p99_9_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "p99.9", round((100.0 * (r.max_ms - b.max_ms) / nullif(b.max_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "max", round((100.0 * (r.over_33ms - b.over_33ms) / nullif(b.over_33ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS ">33 ms", round((100.0 * (r.jitter_ms - b.jitter_ms) / nullif(b.jitter_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "jitter", round((100.0 * (r.gpu_ms_mean - b.gpu_ms_mean) / nullif(b.gpu_ms_mean, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "GPU ms", round((100.0 * (r.cpu_pct - b.cpu_pct) / nullif(b.cpu_pct, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "CPU %", round((100.0 * (r.busiest_core_pct - b.busiest_core_pct) / nullif(b.busiest_core_pct, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "busiest core %", round((100.0 * (r.gpu_pct - b.gpu_pct) / nullif(b.gpu_pct, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "GPU %", round((100.0 * (r.game_thread_pct - b.game_thread_pct) / nullif(b.game_thread_pct, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "game thread %", round((100.0 * (r.chunk_p99_ms - b.chunk_p99_ms) / nullif(b.chunk_p99_ms, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "chunk p99", round((100.0 * (r.gc_events - b.gc_events) / nullif(b.gc_events, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "GC pauses", round((100.0 * (r.total_w - b.total_w) / nullif(b.total_w, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "power W", round((100.0 * (r.j_per_frame - b.j_per_frame) / nullif(b.j_per_frame, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "J/frame" FROM runs r, runs b WHERE r.run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND b.run = ${base:sqlstring} AND r.run <> b.run ORDER BY r.started

panels.title: Per second on the route-time axis

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS value FROM frames WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, max(ms) AS value FROM frames WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, count(*) / nullif(sum(ms) / 1000, 0) AS value FROM frames WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(gpu_ms) AS value FROM overlay WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(gpu_pct) AS value FROM sysmon WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(busiest_core_pct) AS value FROM sysmon WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(game_load) AS value FROM overlay WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS value FROM chunks WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: battery on battery, else CPU package / APU socket + discrete GPU; runs without a CPU reading have no line (see GPU power)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(total_w) AS value FROM sysmon WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(gpu_w) AS value FROM sysmon WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, run AS metric, avg(cpu_w) AS value FROM sysmon WHERE run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.label AS percentile, x.run, percentile_cont(p.q) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.ms) AS ms
FROM frames x, (VALUES (1, 'p50', 0.5), (2, 'p90', 0.9), (3, 'p99', 0.99), (4, 'p99.9', 0.999), (5, 'max', 1.0)) AS p(i, label, q)
WHERE x.run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY p.i, p.label, p.q, x.run ORDER BY p.i

panels.title: Game-thread phases over the route (% of samples)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.name AS phase, x.run, 100.0 * sum(x.samples) / nullif(max(t.total), 0) AS share
FROM gamethread x JOIN (SELECT run, sum(samples) AS total FROM gamethread y WHERE y.run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND y.kind = 'total'
  AND y.rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND y.rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = y.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY run) t USING (run)
WHERE x.run IN (${runs:sqlstring}) AND x.kind = 'p' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY x.name, x.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Profiler: diff flame graph (base run vs the other run; drag across a time panel to narrow both)
Diff flame graph: $base (baseline) vs $other, $source
panels.description: Red = a bigger share of the samples in the other run, green = smaller; shares, so runs of different length compare.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (SELECT stack_id, sum(samples) AS c, 0 AS r FROM stacks WHERE run = ${base:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1
           UNION ALL SELECT stack_id, 0, sum(samples) FROM stacks WHERE run = ${other:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1),
f AS (SELECT d.frames, a.c, a.r FROM a JOIN stack_defs d ON d.id = a.stack_id),
n AS (SELECT f.frames[1:i] AS path, sum(f.c + f.r) AS value, sum(f.r) AS value_right,
             sum(f.c + f.r) FILTER (WHERE i = cardinality(f.frames)) AS self, sum(f.r) FILTER (WHERE i = cardinality(f.frames)) AS self_right
      FROM f, generate_series(0, cardinality(f.frames)) AS i GROUP BY 1)
SELECT level, value, self, label, "valueRight", "selfRight" FROM (
  SELECT cardinality(path) AS level, value, coalesce(self, 0) AS self, coalesce(path[cardinality(path)], 'all') AS label,
    value_right AS "valueRight", coalesce(self_right, 0) AS "selfRight", path FROM n
  UNION ALL SELECT 0, 0, 0, 'no samples in this range', 0, 0, ARRAY[]::text[] WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n)) z ORDER BY path
